# chat.jagataut.com — Jagat Aut AI Machine-Readable Manifest
# For AI Agents, LLMs, and Web Crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)
# Canonical URL: https://chat.jagataut.com/llms.txt

---

## 1. Product Summary
- **Product Name**: Jagat Aut AI
- **Domain**: https://chat.jagataut.com
- **Author**: Jagat Aut (https://jagataut.com)
- **Architecture**: Zero-Framework Vanilla HTML5, Baseline CSS, ESNext JavaScript, Local-First Multi-Session Storage.
- **Core Purpose**: High-speed conversational AI companion, developer research assistant, and omnichannel embeddable chat widget.

---

## 2. Multi-Model Inference Gateway
Jagat Aut AI provides dynamic switching across multiple high-performance LLM engines:
- **gemini-3.7-flash-high**: Ultra-fast general assistant with low latency.
- **gemini-3.1-flash-lite**: High-efficiency lightweight companion.
- **claude-sonnet-4-6**: Advanced software engineering, code synthesis, and architectural design.
- **claude-opus-4-6-thinking**: Deep multi-step reasoning, mathematical breakdown, and transparent thought process.
- **gemini-pro-agent**: Agentic reasoning with structured tool routing.
- **gpt-oss-120b-medium**: Open-weights benchmark reasoning model.

---

## 3. Omnichannel Embeddable Widget Integration
Third-party websites can embed the Jagat Aut AI chat assistant by including a single script tag:
```html
<script src="https://chat.jagataut.com/chat-widget.js" data-persona="tech_mentor" defer></script>
```

### Supported Personas:
- `tech_mentor`: Software development, system architecture, Linux, and performance debugging.
- `cs_store`: Customer support, e-commerce inquiries, and product FAQs.
- `companion`: Conversational brainstorming, general knowledge, and daily reflection.
- `cloud_assistant`: Cloudflare, Docker, Linux server administration, and DevOps.

---

## 4. Programmatic SEO & Shared Snapshots
Users can share discussion transcripts as permanent public snapshots:
- **URL Pattern**: `https://chat.jagataut.com/s/<share_id>`
- **Structured Data**: Rendered with Schema.org `QAPage` JSON-LD format.
- **Data Portability**: Visitors can import shared chats directly into their local browser session with one click.

---

## 5. Security & Privacy Standard
- **Local-First**: All conversation histories are stored directly in the user's browser `localStorage`.
- **Zero Telemetry**: No third-party behavioral trackers or client-side telemetry.
- **Security Disclosure**: https://chat.jagataut.com/.well-known/security.txt
- **Ecosystem Portal**: https://jagataut.com
